# Photo fixtures

Real photographs and graphics, used to check the codecs against content that
behaves like the images this package actually encodes. Synthetic patterns
compress unlike anything real, which makes them a poor guide to both output
size and encoding speed.

| File                    | Source                                                                                                                                            | Author                                  | Licence              |

| `earth.jpg`             | [The Earth seen from Apollo 17](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Earth_seen_from_Apollo_17.jpg)                                        | NASA / Apollo 17 crew                   | Public domain (NASA) |

| `cheetah.jpg`           | [Cheetah](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Cheetah.JPG)                                                                                    | Erik Damen                              | Public domain        |

are downscaled from the Wikimedia Commons originals. The other fixtures keep
their original dimensions and file formats.
